rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis specifies the exact same intervention as the target: comparing equiatomic NbMoTaW with a Re-containing equiatomic NbMoTaWRe film before and after 120 keV He2+ implantation at the same fluence and dose rate.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis lists all the same processing and testing conditions as the target, including deposition parameters, irradiation details, nanoindentation settings, micropillar compression parameters, and SRIM calculation specifics.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis describes the identical mechanism: Re addition creates defect-sink sites (grain boundaries, lattice distortion, excess volumes, amorphous regions) that suppress He-bubble growth and segregation, preventing boundary embrittlement and hardening.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts the same outcome as the target: improved He-irradiation resistance with smaller, more uniform bubbles, less hardening, and less grain-boundary embrittlement for NbMoTaWRe relative to NbMoTaW.
